title: SMIG emergency checklist
description: An emergency checklist that can be imported into SMIG (Settings > Emergency checklists > Import). A checklist is an ordered list of chapters; each chapter is an ordered list of items. Items are tasks to tick off, decisions with options to choose between, and a button that completes the whole checklist. Besides the rules in this schema, SMIG requires that at least one chapter contains a Completion item, and that every chapter or item title referenced from an option's 'proceedToChapter' or 'disables' matches exactly one chapter or item.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, so that editors can offer completion and validation.

name.description: Name of the checklist, typically the emergency it is for, e.g. 'Fire in engine room'.

description.description: Optional short description of when to use the checklist.

chapters.description: The chapters in the order they are worked through.

chapter.description: A group of items, e.g. a numbered section or phase of the procedure.

title.description: Chapter title. Options refer to chapters by this title, so it must be unique if referenced.

items.description: The items in the order they appear in the chapter.

task.description: A step that the operator carries out and ticks off.

title.description: Short instruction, e.g. 'Close fire doors'. Options refer to items by this title, so it must be unique if referenced.

text.description: Optional details or explanation shown under the title.

decision.description: A question where the operator picks one of several options, e.g. 'Is the fire contained?'.

title.description: The question. Options refer to items by this title, so it must be unique if referenced.

options.description: The possible answers. Write an answer as a plain string when it only has a title, or as an object when it has details, jumps to a chapter or disables items.

option.description: An answer to a decision with details or consequences.

text.description: Optional details shown with the answer.

proceedToChapter.description: Title of the chapter to continue with when this answer is chosen, e.g. for 'If no, go to section 4'.

disables.description: Titles of the tasks, decisions or completion buttons that no longer apply when this answer is chosen.

completion.description: The button that marks the whole checklist as completed, usually the last item of the last chapter.

button.description: Label of the button, e.g. 'Complete checklist'. Options refer to this item by this label.
